```{r functions-import, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# FUNCTIONS - Import Data
# ============================================================================

#' Load and parse XML configuration file
#' @param path_file Path to XML config file
#' @return Parsed XML document
load_config <- function(path_file = "config.xml") {
    if (!file.exists(path_file)) {
        stop("Config file not found: ", path_file)
    }
    read_xml(path_file)
}

#' Load race results from JSON
#' @param path_file Path to boats_result.json
#' @return List with race results
load_race_results <- function(path_file = "boats_result.json") {
    if (!file.exists(path_file)) {
        stop("Results file not found: ", path_file)
    }
    fromJSON(path_file)
}

#' Load boat information from JSON
#' @param path_file Path to boatinfo.json
#' @return List with boat information
load_boat_info <- function(path_file = "boatinfo.json") {
    if (!file.exists(path_file)) {
        stop("Boat info file not found: ", path_file)
    }
    fromJSON(path_file)
}

#' Extract route waypoints from config XML
#' @param config_xml Parsed XML document
#' @return List of route segments (each segment is a data.frame with lat/lon)
extract_routes <- function(config_xml) {
    routes <- xml_find_all(config_xml, ".//leg/route")
    
    route_list <- list()
    
    for (i in seq_along(routes)) {
        route_text <- xml_text(routes[i])
        route_id <- xml_attr(routes[i], "id")
        
        waypoints <- strsplit(route_text, ";")[[1]]
        
        wp_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(waypoints, function(wp) {
            coords <- strsplit(wp, ",")[[1]]
            data.frame(
                lat = as.numeric(coords[1]),
                lon = as.numeric(coords[2])
            )
        }))
        
        wp_df$order <- seq_len(nrow(wp_df))
        
        route_list[[i]] <- list(
            id = ifelse(is.null(route_id), paste0("route_", i), route_id),
            waypoints = wp_df
        )
    }
    
    return(route_list)
}

#' Extract race metadata from config
#' @param config_xml Parsed XML document
#' @return List with race metadata
extract_race_metadata <- function(config_xml) {
    config <- xml_find_first(config_xml, ".//config")
    
    list(
        name = xml_attr(config, "name"),
        category = xml_attr(config, "category"),
        state = xml_attr(config, "state"),
        date = xml_attr(config, "date"),
        start = xml_attr(xml_find_first(config, ".//leg"), "start"),
        arrival = xml_attr(xml_find_first(config, ".//leg"), "arrival"),
        leg_num = as.integer(xml_attr(xml_find_first(config, ".//leg"), "num"))
    )
}

#' Extract legs/runs information
#' @param config_xml Parsed XML document
#' @return Data frame with leg/run information
extract_runs <- function(config_xml) {
    runs <- xml_find_all(config_xml, ".//leg/runs/run")
    
    run_data <- lapply(runs, function(run) {
        data.frame(
            id = as.integer(xml_attr(run, "id")),
            length = as.numeric(xml_attr(run, "length")),
            start_name = xml_attr(xml_find_first(run, ".//start"), "name"),
            start_date = xml_attr(xml_find_first(run, ".//start"), "date"),
            arrival_name = xml_attr(xml_find_first(run, ".//arrival"), "name"),
            arrival_lat = as.numeric(xml_attr(xml_find_first(run, ".//arrival"), "lat")),
            arrival_lon = as.numeric(xml_attr(xml_find_first(run, ".//arrival"), "lng"))
        )
    })
    
    do.call(rbind, run_data)
}
```

```{r functions-boat, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# FUNCTIONS - Boat Information
# ============================================================================

#' Extract boat information from config XML
#' @param config_xml Parsed XML document
#' @return Data frame with all boat information
extract_boats_from_config <- function(config_xml) {
    boat_classes <- xml_find_all(config_xml, ".//boats/boat-class")
    
    all_boats <- list()
    
    for (bc in boat_classes) {
        category <- xml_attr(bc, "name")
        run_id <- as.integer(xml_attr(bc, "runid"))
        
        boats <- xml_find_all(bc, ".//boat")
        
        for (boat in boats) {
            boat_id <- as.integer(xml_attr(boat, "id"))
            boat_name <- xml_attr(boat, "name")
            hull_colors <- xml_attr(boat, "hullcolors")
            track_color <- xml_attr(boat, "trackcolor")
            nb_hulls <- as.integer(xml_attr(boat, "nbhulls"))
            coef <- as.integer(xml_attr(boat, "coef"))
            
            navigators <- xml_find_all(boat, ".//crew/navigator")
            skippers <- sapply(navigators, function(nav) {
                fname <- xml_attr(nav, "fname")
                lname <- xml_attr(nav, "lname")
                paste(fname, lname, sep = " ")
            })
            
            all_boats[[length(all_boats) + 1]] <- data.frame(
                boat_id = boat_id,
                boat_name = boat_name,
                category = category,
                run_id = run_id,
                skipper_1 = ifelse(length(skippers) >= 1, skippers[1], NA),
                skipper_2 = ifelse(length(skippers) >= 2, skippers[2], NA),
                hull_colors = hull_colors,
                track_color = track_color,
                nb_hulls = nb_hulls,
                coef = coef
            )
        }
    }
    
    do.call(rbind, all_boats)
}

#' Enrich race results with boat information
#' @param results Race results list from JSON
#' @param boat_info Boat info list from JSON
#' @return Enriched data frame
enrich_results <- function(results, boat_info) {
    result_df <- as.data.frame(results$result)
    result_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(result_df, "boat_id")
    result_df$boat_id <- as.integer(result_df$boat_id)
    
    boats_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, lapply(names(boat_info), function(id) {
        data.frame(
            boat_id = as.integer(id),
            boat_name = boat_info[[id]]$boatName,
            skipper_names = boat_info[[id]]$skipperNames,
            category = boat_info[[id]]$category
        )
    })))
    
    merged <- merge(result_df, boats_df, by = "boat_id", all.x = TRUE)
    
    return(merged)
}
```

```{r functions-analysis, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# FUNCTIONS - Race Analysis
# ============================================================================

#' Calculate distance between two points (Haversine)
#' @param lat1, lon1 Latitude and longitude of point 1
#' @param lat2, lon2 Latitude and longitude of point 2
#' @return Distance in nautical miles
calculate_distance_nm <- function(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
    lat1 <- lat1 * pi / 180
    lat2 <- lat2 * pi / 180
    lon1 <- lon1 * pi / 180
    lon2 <- lon2 * pi / 180
    
    dlat <- lat2 - lat1
    dlon <- lon2 - lon1
    
    a <- sin(dlat/2)^2 + cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(dlon/2)^2
    c <- 2 * atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1-a))
    
    distance_km <- 6371 * c
    distance_nm <- distance_km / 1.852
    
    return(distance_nm)
}

#' Get leaderboard sorted by rank
#' @param results_df Enriched results data frame
#' @param n Number of top boats to show
#' @return Ordered data frame
get_leaderboard <- function(results_df, n = 10) {
    results_df %>%
        arrange(rank) %>%
        head(n) %>%
        select(boat_id, boat_name, rank, heading, speed, dtf, dtl, skipper_names, category)
}

#' Get top performers by 24-hour distance
#' @param results_df Enriched results data frame
#' @param n Number of top boats to show
#' @return Data frame sorted by 24h distance
get_top_24h_distance <- function(results_df, n = 10) {
    results_df %>%
        arrange(desc(`24hour_distance`)) %>%
        head(n) %>%
        select(boat_id, boat_name, `24hour_distance`, speed, skipper_names, category)
}

#' Get top performers by speed
#' @param results_df Enriched results data frame
#' @param n Number of top boats to show
#' @return Data frame sorted by speed
get_top_speed <- function(results_df, n = 10) {
    results_df %>%
        arrange(desc(speed)) %>%
        head(n) %>%
        select(boat_id, boat_name, speed, heading, skipper_names, category)
}

#' Get boats by category with statistics
#' @param results_df Enriched results data frame
#' @return Category summary statistics
get_category_stats <- function(results_df) {
    results_df %>%
        group_by(category) %>%
        summarise(
            n_boats = n(),
            avg_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_speed = max(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_24h_distance = mean(`24hour_distance`, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_dtf = mean(dtf, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        arrange(desc(n_boats))
}

#' Calculate distance to finish for each boat
#' @param results_df Enriched results data frame
#' @param routes Route waypoints list
#' @return Data frame with DTF recalculated
recalculate_dtf <- function(results_df, routes) {
    route <- routes[[1]]$waypoints
    
    dtf_calc <- apply(results_df, 1, function(row) {
        last_lat <- row$lat_dec
        last_lon <- row$lon_dec
        
        arrival_lat <- tail(route$lat, 1)
        arrival_lon <- tail(route$lon, 1)
        
        calculate_distance_nm(last_lat, last_lon, arrival_lat, arrival_lon)
    })
    
    results_df$dtf_calculated <- dtf_calc
    return(results_df)
}

#' Generate daily summary report
#' @param results_df Enriched results data frame
#' @param routes Route waypoints list
#' @return List with summary statistics
generate_daily_summary <- function(results_df, routes = NULL) {
    n_boats <- nrow(results_df)
    
    list(
        timestamp = Sys.time(),
        n_boats_racing = sum(results_df$finished != "true", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_boats_finished = sum(results_df$finished == "true", na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_speed = mean(results_df$speed, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_speed = max(results_df$speed, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_24h_distance = mean(results_df$`24hour_distance`, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_24h_distance = max(results_df$`24hour_distance`, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_dtf = mean(results_df$dtf, na.rm = TRUE),
        min_dtf = min(results_df$dtf, na.rm = TRUE),
        category_summary = get_category_stats(results_df)
    )
}
```

```{r data-loading, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ============================================================================

data_loaded <- FALSE

tryCatch({
    config <- load_config("../data/config.json")
    results <- load_race_results("../data/boats_result.json")
    boat_info <- load_boat_info("../data/boatinfo.json")
    data_loaded <- TRUE
}, error = function(e) {
    cat("Note: Could not load all data files.\n")
    cat("Error:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
})

if (data_loaded) {
    routes <- extract_routes(config)
    metadata <- extract_race_metadata(config)
    runs <- extract_runs(config)
    enriched <- enrich_results(results, boat_info)
}
```
